name: Kaili, Guizhou
tagline: Heart of Miao Culture, Home of Sour Soup Fish
intro: Gateway to the Miao and Dong ethnic heartland, Kaili is famous for the world's largest Miao village and the sour, savoury hotpot that defines Guizhou cuisine. Expect vibrant silver jewellery, lilting folk song and some of the friendliest small-city dentistry in the region.

highlights.name: Xijiang Qianhu Miao Village (西江千户苗寨)
highlights.description: The largest Miao settlement on Earth — over 1,000 stilted wooden houses cascading down a hillside, lit up at night like a galaxy.

highlights.name: Miao Silver Jewellery
highlights.description: Watch master silversmiths hand-forge intricate heirloom pieces; a uniquely Guizhou souvenir.

highlights.name: Sour Soup Fish (酸汤鱼)
highlights.description: Kaili is the birthplace of this tangy, fermented-chilli hotpot — a flavour you will crave forever after.

highlights.name: Lusheng Festival & Folk Song
highlights.description: If your dates align, catch the bamboo lusheng pipes and embroidered costumes of local festivals.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kaili
itinerary.description: Transfer in; evening stroll and local dinner.

itinerary.title: Treatment & Rest
itinerary.description: Clinic consultation and first session; gentle evening.

itinerary.title: Xijiang Miao Village
itinerary.description: Full day in the thousand-household village; cable car and cultural shows.

itinerary.title: Silver & Souvenirs
itinerary.description: Silversmith workshops and relaxed recovery walk.

medical.advantages: Kaili is the network's deepest single-city coverage — five clinics in one prefecture capital. For international patients this is the practical difference between a workable plan and a difficult one: appointments can be rebooked locally within hours, and if your treatment needs a different discipline, it is usually available the same week rather than the same quarter. It is also an excellent choice for travellers who want deep cultural immersion away from the big cities.
